system.description:
You focus chakra throughout your body reinforcing it to hostile effects. Roll a d20, using the result in place of your failed one. Once you cast this jutsu, you cannot do so again for 1 minute.

At Higher Levels: Your skill with this jutsu increases as you gain levels. You no longer need Hand Seals (HS) to cast this jutsu at 5th level. You can cast this jutsu twice per 10 minutes at 11th level and you can cast this jutsu at no Action cost, when its trigger would allow it to be cast at 17th level.
